profile.name: EPICS 过程变量记录器
profile.description: 用于实验控制系统的非物理软件组件，负责连接并监测 EPICS 过程变量（PV），按配置创建日志目录、持续采集数据、处理新增监测请求，并在收到停止信号后结束记录。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for laboratory control systems that connects to and monitors EPICS process variables (PVs), creates logging folders from configuration, continuously collects data, handles requests for newly monitored PVs, and stops logging when an exit signal is received.

registry.name: EPICS PV Logger
registry.description: PV Logger是由EPICS (Argonne National Lab)生产的专业实验设备。wraps a PV for logging
